name: Ash Creek
body:
## Overview

Ash Creek is a small frontier settlement built around the Blackstone Line railway. Home to miners, ranchers, and railroad workers, it serves as a modest supply stop on the edge of the western frontier. Most travelers pass through without a second thought.

## Notables

- Blackstone Railway Depot
- The Cinder Spur Saloon
- St. Mercy Chapel
